profile.summary: Panchmahal Steel Limited manufactures and sells stainless steel long products in the form of wire rods, bars, and wires in India and internationally. It offers stainless steel wire rods; cold finished bars for precise engineering; and bars for free machining. The company also provides wires for braiding, weaving, knitting, filters, springs, and ball making, as well as for cold heading and fastener
